switchPendingNextTurn: Takes effect on the next turn

descriptions.full: Runs everything without asking. Anything you've told mu not to do is still blocked.
descriptions.jev: Reads and edits inside the project go ahead. Jev decides on commands, changes outside the project and actions outside this computer, and asks you only when it's unsure.
descriptions.ask: Only reads go ahead. mu asks you before every edit, command and action outside this computer.
